item.content:encoded:
Gradient Descent · Thursday, August 13, 2026 · 7 articles · ~3 min read

Today's Brief

Think of the AI market like a sports league, where new players can suddenly change the game by offering similar performance at a lower price, like a younger athlete who can run faster without needing as much training. This shift is already being felt on trading desks, where investors are reevaluating their bets on Google's Gemini, which is losing ground to ChatGPT and Claude. As you consider your own investments in AI, whether in sports performance or data tools, you might ask: what happens when the playing field is leveled by affordable, high-performing AI models, and do you need to adjust your strategy to stay ahead?

📊 AI & Data Tools

SpaceXAI's Grok 4.6 matches OpenAI's best model and undercuts it on price

Grok 4.6 scores 61 points on the Artificial Analysis Intelligence Index, tying GPT-5.6 Sol and trailing only Anthropic's Claude Opus 5, at a price more than 60 percent lower. This changes the budgeting decision for companies choosing between Grok 4.6 and other AI models, allowing them to consider a more affordable option with similar performance. → Read

Google's Gemini is losing market share to ChatGPT and Claude according to new market data

Google's Gemini has dropped from 12 to 1.9 percent market share, while OpenAI holds over 50 percent and Anthropic grew from 4.3 to 14.9 percent. This changes the market research workflow for companies tracking AI market trends, requiring them to reassess their investment and partnership strategies with Gemini, ChatGPT, and Claude. → Read

AllenAI Open Instruct Tulu 3 Post-Training with SFT, DPO, RLVR, GRPO, and Verifier-Based Evaluation

AllenAI's Open Instruct framework allows for building a custom LLM post-training pipeline using Supervised Fine-Tuning, Direct Preference Optimization, and Reinforcement Learning with Verifiable Rewards. This changes the LLM development tool for researchers and developers, enabling them to create customized models efficiently on 16GB hardware without requiring extensive resources. → Read

🏃 AI in Sports

My Old Running Routine Stopped Working When I Turned 40. These 7 Changes Made Me Stronger.

7 small tweaks to training can improve running performance after age 40. This changes the approach to training routines for runners in their 40s, who can now adjust their workouts to include these specific changes and potentially see improvement. → Read

The International Olympic Committee advances a second Consensus Statement on Mental Health in Elite Athletes

The International Olympic Committee published a Consensus Statement on Mental Health in Elite Athletes in 2019, which led to a series of initiatives. This changes the mental health support systems for elite athletes, who can now expect a more comprehensive approach to addressing their mental health needs. → Read

Refining mental health literacy strategies in elite sport

Elite athletes and coaches require comprehensive, multilevel interventions for mental health prevention, identification, and treatment. This changes the approach to mental health support in elite sports, which can now focus on implementing these interventions to better support athletes and coaches. → Read
